items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: He wanted Robert Johnson but Johnson had been killed.

ctx.x: If you look on my original program that I found, at the top you know is a drawing of Bessie Smith, who died before the concert obviously. He wanted Robert Johnson but Johnson had been killed. I mean that’s just the way it was. So anyway, if you look at the program in the box set at the top it says, “The New Masses Present Spirituals to Swing.” John Hammond went to everybody in New York to sponsor him for the program, to help pay for it. The NAACP turned him down because, he said, “We don’t want to be associated…
Present,” the “New Masses” was a communist newspaper in New York. And that’s the only group he could get to help sponsor the first concert.
